title: vgio/rig/v10.0
description: A vgio/rig/v10.0 file, as VisualGeometryToolkitIO writes and reads it; generated from its validator (VisualGeometryToolkitIO.json_schema). The validator is the authority: a check stated only in a `description` is the reader's. A file of a higher minor version of this major may hold keys this version does not declare: validate it against its own version's schema. a rig has sensors, targets or both — an empty `sensors` or `targets` is omitted, not written — and member ids are unique

schema.description: vgio/rig/v10.0, or the same major version at any minor

length.description: a registered length unit (mm, cm, m, um, inch)

pixel.description: a registered pixel frame (colmap, opencv, julia)

length_roles.description: length role → its length unit, for the fields whose lengths are not in `length`; "chart": a chart role, its numbers a chart's (plain)

anyOf.description: a registered length unit (mm, cm, m, um, inch)

lens.description: VisualGeometryToolkitCore's lens record (`lens_record`): every key a lens leaf's tag or a combinator (`add`, `lift`, `spline`), every value its coefficient array of the leaf's arity, as `lens_from_record` reads it

pitch.description: a pixel pitch is two positive lengths per pixel, in units.length

prefixItems.title: theta
prefixItems.description: the major axis's angle from +x, rad

then.description: `lens_coverage` is exactly one of `circle` (r > 0), `ellipse` (a ≥ b > 0) or `rect` (width, height > 0)

type.description: "noncentral_spline" — a central grid camera is a camera with a spline lens (its `lens` the spline record)

present.description: the present nodes as runs per row, [[row, [[col_lo, col_hi], …]], …], 1-based: each row once, rows increasing; a row's runs nonempty, col_lo ≤ col_hi, increasing and apart (a gap of at least one node)

spline.description: the area's width and height are > 0; the lattice has at least 4 × 4 nodes; `present` names rows ≤ grid_size.height and columns ≤ grid_size.width; every control array has one entry per held node (grid_size.width × grid_size.height without `present`)

pitch.description: a pixel pitch is two positive lengths per pixel, in units.length

prefixItems.title: theta
prefixItems.description: the major axis's angle from +x, rad

then.description: `lens_coverage` is exactly one of `circle` (r > 0), `ellipse` (a ≥ b > 0) or `rect` (width, height > 0)

covariance.description: a covariance in the storage it holds: 2 × 2 rows (symmetric), {"diagonal": [its diagonal]} or {"isotropic": λ} (λ·I); in the value's tangent order and the file's units
a covariance in the storage it holds: 3 × 3 rows (symmetric), {"diagonal": [its diagonal]} or {"isotropic": λ} (λ·I); in the value's tangent order and the file's units

points.description: the points are all `xy` (a plane's) or all `xyz`; every point states its `covariance`, or none does

layout.description: `type` is a layout's tag (VisualGeometryToolkitCore's TARGET_LAYOUT_TAGS), and the record states exactly that layout's keys

covariance.description: a covariance in the storage it holds: n × n rows (symmetric), {"diagonal": [its diagonal]} or {"isotropic": λ} (λ·I); in the value's tangent order and the file's units
a covariance in the storage it holds: n × n rows (symmetric), {"diagonal": [its diagonal]} or {"isotropic": λ} (λ·I); in the value's tangent order and the file's units

calibration.description: `type` is a calibration kind's tag (VisualGeometryToolkitCore's TARGET_CALIBRATION_TAGS) or "composition". A kind states the keys its type takes (thin_plate_spline, height_field: `nodes`, at least one, and `parameters`; rigid: neither; any other: `parameters`), as many parameters as VisualGeometryToolkitCore's `length_mask` of the kind has, and a `covariance` over them (n × n, symmetric) only where it has parameters. A composition states `compose`: 2 to 6 kinds in the canonical order [height_field, thin_plate_spline, euclidean, scale, aspect, skew], each at most once, the outer map first, none a composition or carrying a covariance (the composition's covers every member's parameters).

size.description: a board's width and height are > 0

path.description: a path relative to the file that names it

sha256.description: a SHA-256 hex digest (64 lowercase hex digits)

texture.description: a canvas texture's width and height are > 0

canvas.description: a canvas's width and height are ≥ 0

target.description: a point_target states its `points` and nothing else; a planar_target states its `calibration` and its design by exactly one of `reference`, `nominal` or `layout`, and no `points`

covariance.description: a covariance in the storage it holds: 6 × 6 rows (symmetric), {"diagonal": [its diagonal]} or {"isotropic": λ} (λ·I); in the value's tangent order and the file's units
